neighbours.label: ' enough' after an adjective, especially 'not X enough'
fire: The evidence was not strong enough to convince the jury.
His score was high enough to win a place on the team.
The ice is not thick enough to walk on yet.
She felt she was never fast enough for the coach.
The room was barely big enough for two beds.
Their offer was not generous enough, so we declined.
Is the water warm enough for the baby's bath?
The rope turned out to be long enough to reach the ledge.
quiet: The evidence was very weak and did not convince the jury.
His score was high, so he won a place on the team.
The ice is still too thin to walk on.
She felt she was always too slow for the coach.
The room was small and held only two beds.
Their offer was rather low, so we declined.
Is the water too hot for the baby's bath?
The rope turned out to reach the ledge after all.

notes: Card peaks are mixed (than, nothing, diet, enough, age); probe of near-copies only reached 0.30 on 'not good enough'. Narrow guess.
